notes: Two-stage system: (1) deterministic analysis parses all 780 pairs/episode, keeps only same-module pairs (cross-module pairs are isolated by construction), scores each by shared-file + changed-symbol + def<->call overlap; exactly 20 same-module candidate pairs surfaced per episode. (2) One Claude (Opus 4.8) agent per episode read the candidate dossier and ranked all 20 by pair-induced-conflict likelihood with decision/confidence/explanation. latencyMs is agent wall-clock (ranked-file write span). Token/cost not aggregated by wrapper -> null.
